questions.stem: Why does dry hydrogen chloride gas not behave as an acid?

options.text: It is not a chemical compound
It needs water to ionise and release H⁺ ions

questions.explanation: Dry hydrogen chloride gas contains covalent molecules with no free H⁺ ions. Water is needed to ionise the molecules and release H⁺ ions, which give the solution its acidic properties.

questions.stem: What is the formula of nitric acid?
questions.explanation: Nitric acid has the formula HNO₃. The three common laboratory acids are hydrochloric acid (HCl), sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄), and nitric acid (HNO₃).
